subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add Telegram album/sendMediaGroup support to the bundled Telegram message surface now, and should maintainers port the linked draft fork PR or require a redesigned current-main implementation?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-backed, but the permanent API shape affects the message tool, Telegram action aliases, durable outbound delivery, reply delivery, inline buttons, caption overflow, and Telegram live-proof expectations.

options.title: Port a current-main album implementation
options.body: Use the linked draft as input, but land a current-main Telegram plugin change that covers message.send, reply delivery, outbound payload delivery, fallbacks, tests, docs, and real Telegram proof.

options.title: Narrow to action-only support first
options.body: Add a smaller explicit Telegram action for album sending while leaving automatic reply/payload album batching for a follow-up decision.

options.title: Defer album semantics
options.body: Keep sequential mediaUrls delivery as the supported behavior for now and leave this issue open only if maintainers want the richer Telegram-native UX later.

recommendation.title: Port a current-main album implementation
recommendation.body: Use the linked draft as input, but land a current-main Telegram plugin change that covers message.send, reply delivery, outbound payload delivery, fallbacks, tests, docs, and real Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans Telegram product behavior, message-tool API shape, and current send-funnel ownership where steipete has the strongest routing signal.
